sections.kicker: Prepared for Zac Manor by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Your headline is the promise every brand studio makes. Your clients are better proof than it.
sections.keep: The serif headline with the italic turn. The type already looks considered.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Be known as the obvious choice
pins.what: The headline is a promise any studio could make.
pins.why: This is what reads as mediocre: obvious choice is the line of the category.
pins.how: Say what you make people the obvious choice for, and for whom.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Prospects meet a promise they have seen on ten other studio sites.

pins.quote: I partner with teams to build their trust
pins.what: The subline describes campaigns, the name describes a person.
pins.why: It is unclear whether Zac Manor is a brand studio, a campaign shop or a freelancer.
pins.how: Pick one frame and name it the same way everywhere.
pins.label: Your subline
pins.cost: Prospects cannot tell what they would hire you for.

pins.area: Client logos Kona Ice and Pillar Architecture sit in light grey under the hero
pins.what: Real client logos sit in light grey under the hero.
pins.why: Kona Ice and Pillar Architecture are proof, and they are faded almost out of sight.
pins.how: Show the work behind those names right after the headline.
pins.label: Your clients
pins.cost: Your best evidence reads as a watermark.

sections.intro: You told us you worry the brand is mediocre and you want it to look like the studio you are. It is not mediocre. It is unspecific.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Zac Manor's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Pentagram, from another category. It shows the work first and lets the work make the claim.
